actor.reason:
REACHED THE GOAL.

What I did: I typed a short task into the 'What needs doing?' box and pressed Enter, and it appeared in the list straight away with the counter reading '1 left'. I added a long task describing a plumber call and a third short one. I ticked 'Buy milk', which got struck through. I clicked Active and saw only the two unfinished tasks. I clicked Completed and saw only 'Buy milk', ticked and struck through. I pressed Edit on 'Return library books', added ' by Saturday', and saved. I then deleted the two remaining tasks and pressed Clear completed to remove the finished one. The list ended empty with '0 left'.

What worked: adding with Enter, the checkbox, both filters, Edit and Save, Delete, and Clear completed all did what their labels say. The counter updated correctly every time.

What behaved differently from what I expected:

1. My long task got cut off with no warning. I typed a sentence ending 'before 10, otherwise reschedule for next week'. The saved task stopped at 'before 10, othe'. Nothing told me there was a length limit or that text had been dropped. I only noticed because I read the list afterwards.

2. The limit is inconsistent. When I pressed Edit on that task and typed the missing words back in, Save kept the whole sentence. So the add box cuts text that the edit box accepts. If there is a limit, it should apply the same way in both places, and it should say so.

3. Enter does not save a rename. Enter adds a task from the top box, so I pressed Enter after editing too. The row stayed in edit mode with my new text sitting there. I had to click Save. That inconsistency made me pause and wonder if the edit had failed.

4. The edit box is a single line. For the long task I could only see the first few words and had to press End to reach the end. The list shows the full text wrapped over five lines, so the edit box shrinking it to one line felt cramped.

5. Delete is immediate. No confirmation and no undo. Fine for a tiny list, but a mis-click loses a task for good.

Where I hesitated: after the rename did not save on Enter, I was briefly unsure whether the app had frozen or whether I had done something wrong. Clicking Save fixed it. I also hesitated before deleting, since I did not know whether a confirmation would appear, so I deleted one task first to check.
